name: Play Time
disable: DC 19 Occultism check (trained) to exorcise the spirits of the toy box, DC 20 Athletics check (trained) to hold the toy box closed momentarily, or DC 21 Diplomacy check (trained) to convince the spirits that play time is over; three total success are required to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or if the toy box is destroyed. After 1 hour, if the toy box remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.
routine: (1 action) The toy box belches forth a 15-foot cone of toys, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (chosen randomly each time) with a DC 20 basic Reflex save save.

items.name: Terrifying Toy Box
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the toy box

---
Effect The toy box lid slowly opens with a groan, revealing a yawning chasm into nothingness. Each creature who can see the toy box must attempt a DC 23 Will save save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while the haunt is active.

Critical Failure As failure, but Frightened 4.

text: An old, dusty toy box creaks open and forcefully expels a series of cracked and broken toys.
